name: core-sheet
title: Core: constructable stylesheets
description: adopt(root, css): a piece's styles as one shared constructable stylesheet, so a strict Content-Security-Policy (style-src 'self') has nothing to block. A shadow root adopts it; an element root adopts onto its document, once; a <style> only where adoptedStyleSheets is missing.

motif.gloss: No cultural motif; shared infrastructure, nothing drawn from a tradition.
